title: Ignore local Claude settings in the repository, not only the operator's global excludes
body:
Source: operator-shared news triage 2026-11-08 (Apiiro: agents' "Don't Ask Again" grants committed in 1,122 public settings files).
Evidence: `git check-ignore -v .claude/settings.local.json` matches only the operator's global `~/.config/git/ignore:1`; the repository `.gitignore` has no entry, so a fresh clone, CI runner or worker on another host can commit permission grants.
Deliver: ignore `.claude/settings.local.json` (and `.codex` local equivalents if any) in the repository `.gitignore` and in the adopter init template, with a test that `git check-ignore` matches with an empty global excludes file.
Acceptance: the test runs with `GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null` and `core.excludesFile` unset and passes; the init template test asserts the entry.
